kind: owner final-wheel coding startup defect and candidate pin-cap repair

failed_final_wheel.result: FAIL before inference: OpenCode prompt HTTP 500, UnexpectedStatus, zero generation and zero tool calls
failed_final_wheel.cause: The KRYN product plugin rejected a new session after the owner account reached 500 saved champion pins. Native session storage and the resource guard were healthy; pressure was normal and swap growth zero.

fix: Remove the arbitrary 500-pin admission limit. Existing pins still use the same private, owned, validated per-session files; no pin or native session is silently discarded. Native session history already governs larger long-term storage cost.

candidate_validation.regression: The plugin test created 500 existing pins, admitted a 501st session and verified the older pin bytes remained unchanged.
candidate_validation.guarded_native_run: v1-pinfix-coding-20261002-01: patched product source, same installed stack and daily-use guard. First Agent turn completed with 16 tools, verified local routing, normal pressure and zero swap growth. The frozen Task02 grader passed but an independent canonical-date probe failed.
candidate_validation.supervised_correction: One saved-session Agent feedback turn completed with seven tools under the same guard. Frozen Task02 checks and the separate imported-code canonical-date probe passed; the current diff was inspected. This is supervised success after correction, not autonomous first-pass success.

release_decision: The 997d949 wheel is invalidated by the reproduced product failure. Merge the minimal fix, rebuild from clean main, reinstall the new exact wheel and repeat affected final-artifact gates before publication.
